newsitem.title: GERMANY: Nazi bunker in Berlin due to make way for bank.
newsitem.headline: Nazi bunker in Berlin due to make way for bank.

text.p: A German bank said on Wednesday its construction workers had discovered a Nazi bunker near Hitler's former chancellery and the Brandenburg Gate and planned to blow it up to make room for a new building.

"After we found it on December 17, we decided the easiest way to deal with it would be with explosives," said Christian Schilling, a spokesman for DG Bank in Berlin which is planning a regional office for the site.
"But we are especially concerned about not damaging our neighbours, the Academy of Arts and the Brandenburg Gate," Schilling added.
The 225 sq metre (2,400 sq ft) cement bunker has three living chambers, a kitchen and toilet.
Explosives experts would begin work next week if permission from city authorities was granted, said Schilling.
